title: Starter questions for the Recommendation properties
note: Gives the properties of the Recommendation stage the questions they put to the knowledge base, which a case otherwise guesses from the wording on each run: what overlaps, which contract covers it, which controls apply, who owns the solutions and the capabilities the demand affects (read from the graph's 'is owned by'), and what is open. A question starts from the answer of an earlier property, so where it starts from a property of this stage that property is made to build on it. A property that already has questions of your own is left as it is, and a question that cannot work in your copy (it starts from a property you do not have) is left out, and said. Read each question afterwards under Lookups: they are a starting point to edit, not a final set.

lookups.find: which existing applications or platforms serve the same need as each impacted application, and what state each is in
lookups.extract: the solution, its ID and its status (live, planned or retiring)

lookups.find: which existing initiatives or projects already cover what the demand asks for
lookups.extract: the initiative, its ID and what it covers

lookups.find: which existing solutions each impacted business capability is already served by
whether another demand in this request asks for the same need, for the same users, on the same systems, even if it is worded differently
which contract or licence covers each overlapping solution
lookups.extract: the contract ID, what it covers and its renewal or end date

lookups.find: which contract or licence covers each system the demand names
lookups.extract: the contract ID, what it covers and its renewal or end date

lookups.find: what the standard requires for the data classification this demand involves
the controls linked to each security capability the screening named
lookups.extract: the control, its owner role and its status

lookups.find: which security controls each overlapping solution is covered by
who owns each business capability the demand impacts
whether any overlapping solution is retiring, not in use, or has no initiative behind it
